description: Put a question for the person on the call's Decision Board (shown as #number with buttons; the person can also answer by voice, also freely). Meant for every question the person decides: yes/no, A/B, an approval, picking a value. A question only spoken via say leaves no button and no decision event. Without options it is a yes/no question (buttons Yes/No); options: 2 to 3, max 40 characters each, recommend = index of the recommended option. question: max 160 characters. Longer or more: 422, never cut. Returns id and number. The answer arrives later as a `next` event {type: decision, id, number, verdict: yes|no|option|other, option?, text? (their own answer), by}. Change an open one with id plus new fields, remove it with id and delete true.

id.description: Id of an open decision to change or delete.
id.title: Id

options.description: Optional: 2 to 3 answer options, max 40 characters each; leave out for a yes/no question.
options.title: Options

question.description: The question, max 160 chars (required when creating).
question.title: Question
